before.interpretation: Individually sampled idle/checkpoint counters; yields are not CPU utilization or proof of watchdog safety.

after.interpretation: Individually sampled idle/checkpoint counters; yields are not CPU utilization or proof of watchdog safety.

scheduler_counter_semantics: independent uint32 snapshots; wrap modulo 2^32; yields are not CPU utilization
serial_counter_semantics: local queue/driver observations, not PC delivery
